source.check: divisions, names and parties read from the Irish News's Omagh Rural District nominations (19 April 1933, p. 6) and checked against the Ulster Herald's 'List of nominees' (22 April 1933, p. 5)

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors. Nominations were received by Mr. Patrick Gormley, clerk, on 18 April 1933 and, there being no contest in any division, the whole council was returned unopposed. Polling in County Tyrone was fixed for 1 June 1933. The Irish News prints the complete list of the thirty-nine divisions. Filed on 1933-05-31, the polling day for county council and rural district elections in Co. Tyrone that year (confirmed); previously filed under 1933-06-01 (verification 5 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
